# Agentic Orchestration Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the orchestration is a real stateful, non-linear model and not sequential chaining
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Non-Linearity and Model

- [ ] CHK001 - Is a test defined that a purely sequential agent chain fails (explicit graph, at least one parallel fan-out, one join, one conditional branch)? [Measurability, Spec CON-005, FR-105, FR-106, Constitution II] [M, G0] {Detects: linear-chaining}
- [ ] CHK002 - Are nodes, edges (DEPENDS_ON, CONDITIONAL, GATE), and execution order defined as data in a versioned profile, not only in code? [Completeness, ADR-019, Spec FR-105] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-dependency-representation}
- [ ] CHK003 - Is a failure defined when execution order is fixed outside the model? [Coverage, Spec FR-105 NAC] [M, G0] {Detects: linear-chaining}
- [ ] CHK004 - Is each FR-103 stage mapped to exactly one node and each node to a stage, with no orphan stage or node? [Traceability, Spec FR-103, Orchestration §8] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK005 - Do all nodes define inputs, outputs, entry and exit criteria, owner, failure behavior, timeout, retry policy, failure classification, fallback, and audit events? [Completeness, Spec FR-104, Orchestration §8] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are all allowed and prohibited state transitions enumerated, with a defined refusal for each prohibited one? [Completeness, Orchestration §3.2, §3.3] [M, G0]

## State and Lineage

- [ ] CHK007 - Is persistent workflow state defined (contents, store, atomicity with audit), with a failure when state exists only in memory? [Completeness, Spec FR-107, ADR-018] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-persistent-state}
- [ ] CHK008 - Is state defined as the source of truth for resumption, including what is restored? [Clarity, Spec FR-107, FR-121] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-persistent-state}
- [ ] CHK009 - Is decision lineage defined (decisions, assumptions, approvals, artifact versions, consumptions) as never rewritten and traceable to the requirement? [Completeness, Spec FR-108, ADR-018] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-decision-lineage}
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the terminal-state set deterministic and exhaustive, with no undefined terminal? [Completeness, Spec FR-120, Orchestration §5] [M, G0]

## Parallelism, Branching, and Replanning

- [ ] CHK011 - Are fan-out points and concurrently running nodes enumerated? [Completeness, Spec FR-106, Orchestration §2] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is synchronization defined at every join, including when a dependency is skipped or fails, with a dependent never starting early? [Coverage, Spec FR-106 NAC, Orchestration N15] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-synchronization}
- [ ] CHK013 - Are conditional branches defined by named predicates with recorded skip reasons? [Clarity, ADR-019, Spec FR-112] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "suspend only the affected path" measurable (branch and slice granularity), with a negative case where unaffected branches must continue? [Measurability, Spec FR-113, ADR-019, ADR-022] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is dynamic replanning defined (triggers, affected set, materiality rule, approval supersession, carried-over work, failure if unaffected stages re-run)? [Completeness, Spec FR-122, FR-123, ADR-022] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-dynamic-replanning}
- [ ] CHK016 - Is governance preserved on replan (gates and policies re-apply; no reuse of approval for materially changed content)? [Coverage, Spec FR-123] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is interruption and resumption defined per state (RUNNING, AWAITING_WORK, AWAITING_APPROVAL) including lease expiry and duplicate-effect prevention? [Coverage, Orchestration §7.2, Spec FR-121] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-resume}
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the AgentPort contract defined so the orchestrator's expectations of agents are testable? [Clarity, Spec ASM-017, ADR-005] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are scale-out orchestration features explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Spec EXC-006] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
